lines.zh: 我被发现了，就不必再藏。
lines.en: I am spotted, so there is no need to hide.
Cold gaze, staring at you.

lines.zh: 漆黑的皮肤在夜色中蠕动。
lines.en: Black skin moves in the night.
Hoarse throat, constant growl.
Slowly advancing, seeking prey.
Creepy breath, getting closer.
Sharp claws touch the ground gently.
Green eyes flicker irregularly.

lines.zh: 呼吸逐渐加快，接近玩家。
lines.en: Breathing speeds up, nearing player.

lines.zh: 暗中窥伺，随时准备扑击。
lines.en: Sneaking, ready to pounce.
My soles scrape the floor, very softly.

lines.zh: 我在你身后，隔着一扇门。
lines.en: I am behind you, one door away.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，听你吞下药片。
lines.en: I press to the wall and hear you swallow a pill.
Staring distant, seems to think.
Whispering, unknown words.
Shaking gently, trying to hide.
Licking claws, cleaning them.
Scanning, ensuring safety.
Occasionally hiss, relaxing.
Body twitching, alert.
Staring at player, intent unclear.

lines.zh: 低头沉思，似乎有所谋划。
lines.en: Bowing head, scheming.

lines.zh: 我数着你吃的每一粒药。
lines.en: I count every pill you swallow.

lines.zh: 角落的蒲公英垂下了头。
lines.en: The dandelion in the corner droops.
Holding my breath, listening to your heart.

lines.zh: 我站在灯照不到的地方。
lines.en: I stand where the lamp doesn't reach.
You feel its gaze.
It stares at you, heart races.
You dare not blink; neither do I.
It gets closer, nearly invisible.
Its gaze follows you.
You're scared by its gaze.

lines.zh: 你回头，就是为了看见我。
lines.en: You turn to look. That is why I am here.
Pupils dilate, noticing you.
You feel eyes behind you.

lines.zh: 你关灯后，我的眼白更亮。
lines.en: After you kill the light, my eye whites shine.
You turned around—too slow.
My eye is at the edge of your vision.
Did you see me? Just for a second.
Don't blink—I am right there.
How much sanity do you have left?

lines.zh: 药片吃得再多，我也还在。
lines.en: Swallow all the pills you like—I remain.

lines.zh: 你数过房间里的人数吗？
lines.en: Have you counted the people in this room?
When the dandelion wilts, I arrive.

lines.zh: 我在你的余光里停留太久。
lines.en: I linger too long in your peripheral vision.
I memorized that breath of yours.
Feels off...

lines.zh: 你挥的东西划到了我的影子。
lines.en: What you swung grazed my shadow.
I've been found...
Save me!

lines.zh: 这具实体开始变得透明。
lines.en: This body is starting to turn transparent.

lines.zh: 我的形状在灯下抖了抖。
lines.en: My shape shivers under the light.

lines.zh: 我的手指断在墙里，收不回来。
lines.en: My fingers are stuck in the wall.
I can't die...
Don't kill me...
Come quick...
You have my food!
Did you hear that scream?
My vision is beyond yours!
Can you smell me?
You can't escape me!
Darkness is my home.
My claws tear through everything.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我退进更深的黑。
lines.en: You reach out; I retreat into deeper dark.
You're my only food!
I roam this land.

lines.zh: 你的肩穿过我，我笑了一声。
lines.en: Your shoulder passes through me; I laugh.
Get out of my sight!
My speed is unmatched.
You stand in the hallway. Perfect.
You fear my presence!
Our paths are destined to cross!

lines.zh: 你撞进我的影子，我停住了。
lines.en: You stumble into my shadow; I stop.
You’ve touched my senses!

lines.zh: 被你撞见的一刻，我笑出声。
lines.en: The moment you spot me, I laugh out loud.

lines.zh: 你往前一步，我还在原地。
lines.en: You step forward; I remain.
I see you. Don't turn around.
Can you smell me?
My voice calls to my kind.

lines.zh: 你的房间里，只留得下我。
lines.en: In your room, only I can stay.
You tremble at my presence.
My call wakes the night.
My mate is nearby.
My voice pierces the darkness.
I've spotted you.
My call attracts them.
Sssss, getting close.
Watch out! It’s looking for you.
Feel those eyes on you.
Your voice drew it in.
It's sneaking up on you.

lines.zh: 你不知道它就在你附近。
lines.en: You don’t know it’s near you.
It’s hiding in the dark.
It’s tracking your scent.
Its breath is audible.

lines.zh: 被看见的那一刻，我就扑。
lines.en: The moment I'm seen, I lunge.

lines.zh: 你刚关上的门又开了条缝。
lines.en: The door you shut opens a crack again.

lines.zh: 我就在你回头的那一瞬。
lines.en: I'm there the instant you turn.

lines.zh: 你数药片的手停了一下。
lines.en: Your hand pauses over the pills.
Range confirmed.
Beginning pursuit.

lines.zh: 我看见了，你也被看见了。
lines.en: I saw you — and now you're seen.

lines.zh: 你踮脚走路，我还是听见了。
lines.en: You walk on tiptoe; I still hear you.
Your sanity is thinning.

lines.zh: 你呼吸乱了，我知道时间到了。
lines.en: Your breathing falters; it's time.
Attack imminent.

lines.zh: 你的名字刚从我嘴里出来。
lines.en: Your name just left my mouth.

lines.zh: 我记住了你走路的节奏。
lines.en: I memorized the rhythm of your walk.

lines.zh: 你就是那个欠我债的人。
lines.en: You are the one who owes me.
The door is locked—I locked it.
This time I am not just a shadow.
You are already on my list.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，我的眼睛就够了。
lines.en: I need no weapon; my eyes are enough.

lines.zh: 我在你身后，隔着一层呼吸。
lines.en: I'm behind you, one breath away.
You've seen me — so don't hide.
Its heartbeat quickens.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔里映着你的药瓶。
lines.en: My pupils reflect your pill bottle.
It’s about to pounce.
It’s waiting for the right moment.
It has its target locked.
It’s about to attack.
Its claws are taut.

lines.zh: 等你转过身，我就贴上去。
lines.en: When you turn, I'll be against your back.

lines.zh: 我学你呼吸，学得太像了。
lines.en: I copy your breathing—too well.
The pills wore off—time to wake.

lines.zh: 我在你耳后一步的位置。
lines.en: I stay one step behind your ear.

lines.zh: 你的影子比刚才长了一点。
lines.en: Your shadow grew a little longer.

lines.zh: 我数到十，你就会看见我。
lines.en: At ten, you will see me.
Don't look back—if you do, I smile.

lines.zh: 我一直在你视线的死角。
lines.en: I never leave your blind spot.
I know your hallway well.
Wait for the light to die, then we talk.
I'm at your face — just one instant.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸带着你房间的味道。
lines.en: My breath carries the smell of your room.
Come on, taste my teeth!
Turn around and I am already on you.

lines.zh: 我的手贴上你的后颈，冰凉。
lines.en: My hand presses your nape, cold.

lines.zh: 你已经闻到了我的存在！
lines.en: You can smell me now!
Remember the scream I gave you.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，你只感到一阵冷。
lines.en: I bite; you only feel a chill.
You're not getting away!

lines.zh: 你的手臂上多了三道白印。
lines.en: Three pale marks appear on your arm.
My nails dig into your shoulder.
You didn't hear me coming, did you?
This one is real.
I left a mark on your neck.
While you scream, I smile.
Don't be afraid—it's only my shadow.

lines.zh: 你的床头灯闪了第三下。
lines.en: Your bedside lamp flickers a third time.

lines.zh: 蒲公英的影子落在我脚边。
lines.en: The dandelion's shadow falls at my feet.
You can't avoid me!
I hide here, waiting patiently!
I'll always find you!

lines.zh: 我站在你镜子的倒影里。
lines.en: I stand in the reflection of your mirror.

lines.zh: 窗外的蒲公英已经枯了。
lines.en: The dandelion outside has withered.

lines.zh: 墙角多出来的影子站起来了。
lines.en: The extra shadow in the corner stands up.
I will always hunt you!

lines.zh: 你注定要成为我的猎物！
lines.en: You are destined to be my prey!
The light flickered, and there I was.
Your room has one more person now.
I stepped out of the mirror.
That scream was your own.
Don't turn on the light—I see better without it.

lines.zh: 我从你的梦里跟了出来。
lines.en: I followed you out of your dream.
Someone is standing by your bed.
A petal fell from the dandelion.
Look—I have a body now.
Did you hear that scream?

lines.zh: 火从我的影子里爬起来。
lines.en: Fire climbs out of my shadow.
Fell down...

lines.zh: 感觉浑身不对劲...，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Feels off — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 这伤口真疼...，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: That wound really hurts — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我被发现了...，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I've been found — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 快来救我，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Save me! — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我要死了...，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm dying — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 不能再等了...，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Can't wait any longer — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，然后声音就停了。
lines.en: I saw you, and then the sound stopped.
